new_spots.name: Fergburger
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it: a shopfront with a queue of roughly twenty people filling the lower half. The crowd is the subject (IMAGES.md: no people as the subject) and it is a flat street-level frontage. Find a photo of the burger or an uncrowded exterior, or ship with no photo.

new_spots.name: Coronet Peak
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2011, colour): snow-covered ski field and peak, clearly the Coronet Peak Ski Area per Commons category. Right place, named thing, wide and scenic, a real photograph.

new_spots.name: The Remarkables
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2019): the jagged range above Lake Wakatipu from the Skyline side, range dominates the frame, categories The Remarkables/Lake Wakatipu. Passes all four.

new_spots.name: Lake Hayes
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2015): autumn-framed lake with mountains and reflection, categorised Lake Hayes. Right place, the lake is the subject, scenic, real photo.

new_spots.name: Queenstown Hill
new_spots.photo_reason: No photo proposed; none to judge. Wikipedia lead image not checked, coordinator may try it.

new_spots.name: Skippers Canyon
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2008): canyon road and walkers near Skippers Saddle, categorised Skippers Canyon. Walkers are small in frame, not the subject. Scenic, real photograph.

new_spots.name: Arrowtown Chinese Settlement
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2014): a restored stone miners' hut with rusty iron roof, categorised Arrowtown Chinese Settlement. The hut is the attraction itself, so a building close-up is acceptable; colour, in focus. Not spectacular, but nothing better is required for a heritage site.

new_spots.name: Kiwi Park
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2019): a flat shot of the entrance building, slightly sun-flared, with a person at the door. Fails check 3 (an ordinary building, not the attraction visitors come for, which is the birds). Find a kiwi or aviary photo or ship none.

new_spots.name: Queenstown Trail
new_spots.photo_reason: Looked at it (2019): gravel trail beside the Kawarau/Frankton bridges with the Remarkables behind, categorised Queenstown Trail. Right place and a characteristic stretch; acceptable though not spectacular (bridge and railings share the frame).

new_spots.name: Walter Peak High Country Farm
new_spots.photo_reason: No photo proposed; Commons farm photos carry overlaid captions, rejecting them is correct.

existing_fixes.reason: TSS Earnslaw is a vessel/operator, exactly the case COVERAGE.md names; replacing with Walter Peak High Country Farm is right (Wikipedia confirms the steamship's destination is the farm). The replacement has no photo, so add a WIKI_IMAGE_OVERRIDES entry or leave it photo-less; drop any TSS Earnslaw override. The 85 NZD cost is carried over and unverified.

Do not rename to Shotover River: the river's canyon is already covered by the new Skippers Canyon spot, so it would create a near-duplicate, and Shotover Jet is the single best-known ride there. Leave as is (low confidence, a judgment call).

Confirmed: Wikipedia puts Ben Lomond (Otago) summit at -45.007, 168.6156, about 2 km south-west of the current pin (-44.99, 168.625), which is near Bowen Peak. The bio describes the summit climb, so move the pin to about -45.007, 168.6156.
